source: Phase-2 parse-reply regression set (iter-32 parse-1 validation beats): full say-cycle documents distilled from six live agent-in-the-loop sessions over the mode-C door (s1 walkthrough seed 125; s2 the texture pin survives a failed take seed 42; s3 the texture promotion + canon birth seed 4; s4 the fire chain through the door seed 23; s5 the disambiguation family seed 8; s6 the malformed-probe family seed 41) - each replayed through the REAL session stack (Simulator + Mediator + ParserDoor over ONE shared SceneLedger, cli/parser.py + cli/mediator.py). The narrator half (texture establishment) runs through the real mediator beat; the player half through the say door; the two doors share the session's one ledger (D-049). Per PARSER_SPEC §6 the tally: 30 utterances, mix 21 intent / 6 question / 2 no_intent; 7/7 deliberate off-grammar probes caught loudly at the boundary (off-verb, ghost noun, non-integer ticks, off-enum method, two alternatives in one document, consumed texture reference, double apply); 21/21 boundary-accepted intent replies - 0 honest misfires, validity 100% among intent-alternative replies (questions and no-intent verdicts are honest outcomes, not violations); 3 door failures are world answers (take_failed, 2x intent_rejected), 1 door-law error after the pin (the one-path RunnerError, cycle pinned then refused). Session findings pinned per-cycle: the fire cascade drains INSIDE the door's own run_steps batch (drop_break cycle: 5 events, last location_burned_out - the iter-23 batch-boundary lesson through the say door); a PROMOTED texture entry is terminal - re-referencing it is off-grammar, the parser takes the disambiguation path (s6 cycle 3); a failed take keeps its entry live+pinned (s2, seed 42); a committed take IS the promotion (s3/s6, seeds 4/41 - canon birth loc_tavern.candles=lit); talk ripples 2 events (rumor_told). Provenance: worklog iter-32 + the runner (scripts/iter32_parse_runner.py, outside the repo) - the live logs and call/reply documents are gitignored runtime artifacts under the runner's scratch dir. The corpus's job: pin the phase-2 exit criterion's evidence (ROADMAP §2 - the ≥90% valid-intents gate review rides this volume; PARSER_SPEC §6 owns the measurement). Batch 2 (iter-33, the owner's corpus-growth call): four more live sessions through the same stack (s7 the untested-verbs walkthrough seed 111 - examine/use/rest fed through the door for the first time, the undeclared-field probe on a fieldless verb, the wait-720 decay batch draining inside the door's own run_steps (16 events, the iter-23 batch law on the quiet side), the per-cycle state pins: use lands intoxication 20, the wait batch gains fatigue 20 while intoxication decays to 1, the second rest clamps 20-30 to 0 - the tune-1 clamp live; s8 the scene-close retirement seed 65 - a pinned entry dies at the scene close when the player leaves and returns, re-referencing it is off-grammar, the fresh establish in the new scene is legal and the fresh take promotes; s9 the disambiguation ladder seed 30 - question, still-ambiguous answer, re-asked question, then the resolved intent; the verb-muse and world-question no_intent families (an utterance naming a verb with no intent now; a question about the world); the wait-without-ticks probe - boundary-ACCEPTED (the gate does not duplicate door-owned checks, PARSER_SPEC §4), then the door's loud RunnerError, cycle consumed, the fixed reply on a fresh say; s10 the narrator withdrawal seed 32 - the texture-OCC retirement of a PINNED entry (the narrator's own assertion dies; un-pinning does not exist but withdrawal does), re-reference off-grammar, fresh candles legal, the fresh take promotes). Batch 2 tally per §6: 21 utterances (14 intent / 4 question / 2 no_intent + the 1 gate-passed door-rejected cycle), 3/3 deliberate off-grammar probes caught loudly (the undeclared field; the RETIRED-entry re-reference x2 - one scene-close cause, one narrator-withdrawal cause), 14/14 fed intents boundary-valid, 0 honest misfires; 2 world answers (take_failed x2, both texture-path takes whose pins survive) + 1 door-law error. Combined corpus tally: 51 utterances, 35 fed intents / 10 questions / 4 no-intents / 2 gate-passed door-rejected cycles; 10/10 off-grammar probes caught; 35/35 boundary validity (the ≥90% criterion holds on the combined volume); 5 world answers + 2 door-law errors. New live law pinned: RETIRED joins PROMOTED as terminal, and a pinned entry can die two ways - the scene close (leaving) and the narrator withdrawal (OCC) - with the reference off-grammar either way; fresh establishment after RETIRE is legal (a new entry id: the new-candles law). Provenance: worklog iter-33 + the runner (scripts/iter33_parse_runner.py, outside the repo).
